description: This script analyzes TypeScript source files to verify the correctness of imported plugin SDK subpaths against project-specific configurations such as exported subpaths and entrypoints. It scans the project directory, parses source files to identify module specifiers, and reports violations where SDK subpaths are missing from exports or entrypoint listings.

methods.name: readPackageExports
methods.description: Reads and parses the project package.json to retrieve exported plugin SDK subpaths, returning a set of subpath strings.

methods.name: readEntrypoints
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file listing plugin SDK entrypoints, returning a set of entrypoint subpaths excluding 'index'.

methods.name: parsePluginSdkSubpath
methods.description: Extracts and returns the subpath after 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/' from a module specifier string, or null if the specifier does not match the expected pattern.
